title: Static and Protocol
author: Paloma Thornbury
blurb: Theo Nystrom, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
